verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on report (comm-1) showing Scribe transcripts include punctuation, though with a spacing defect in German. Nothing in the pack documents casing, number formatting, or any switch to disable formatting. The natural-language edit instruction (docs-8) is an adjacent post-processing feature, not a formatting toggle. Missing for 10: documented punctuation/casing behavior, number/inverse-text normalization, a parameter to turn formatting off, first-party docs on formatting output.
